Til Nothing Comes Between Us
" is a song written by
Kerry Harvick
, Tony Marty and Rebecca Marshall, and recorded by American
country music
artist
John Michael Montgomery
.  It was released in July 2002 as the first single from the album
Pictures
.  The song reached #19 on the
Billboard
Hot Country Singles & Tracks
chart.
